messages:
ellie_marketing: Quick creative ops ask for the "Inference Benchmarks" launch cycle — small reusable kit please :sparkles:
ellie_marketing: Deliverables (ordered): hero (1600x900 static + 3s GIF + 120x120 SVG loader), vertical mobile hero (600x800) for in-app, interactive micro-tile prototype (HTML/CSS, 300x250 embed), benchmark one-pager (single-column PDF + PNG), inbound routing swimlane (1200x600) + simplified public SVG, and a motion spec doc (keyframes, durations). Include light/dark variants, alt text, and file-size targets.
rafa_design: Got it. Interactive micro-tile prototype — do we want hover vs tap states spelled out? And prefer no heavy JS?
ellie_marketing: Yes hover + tap states, minimal JS, prefer CSS transitions only. Export a minified HTML + annotated CSS variables. For micro-tiles also provide PNG/SVG fallbacks.
marc_growth: CTA variants: Paid: "Register now" (strong accent). Organic: "Save your spot" (softer). Include paid CTA overlay option for micro-tiles and a 600x200 banner for paid channels.
priya_prod: Routing details: public swimlane should show: registration form -> scoring -> Premium queue (score >= 80) OR Standard queue -> AE assignment. After 48 hours unassigned -> SDR. CRM field "inference_use_case" must appear in the internal swimlane, but public SVG should show the field label only (no internal IDs). If you want JSON: { "lead_source": "webinar", "score_threshold": 80, "routing": "premium|standard|SDR" }
jen_legal: Quick legal flag: any comparative phrasing (multiples, % reductions) needs source callout and "typical workloads" qualifier. Send exact headline and benchmark sentences for review and I'll respond within 24h.
ellie_marketing: Benchmark blurb to include (for design only): "Simulated conversational load: median latency 60ms. Caching + batching reduced unit cost by 2.6x (typical workloads)." Mark all comparative language as illustrative and add small footer: "Data shown for illustration only."
rafa_design: Animation note: for hero loader keep 8-12fps, avoid heavy gradients for mobile decoders. Motion spec will include easing, keyframes, and max file-size guidance.
marc_growth: For the benchmark one-pager we need a short narrative paragraph (3-4 lines) + 2 micro-charts: sparkline for cost trend and a bar for median latency. Keep charts simplified.
priya_prod: Public swimlane: please use generic labels "Premium" / "Standard" and avoid exposing queue names. The internal asset must include the CRM field callout.
rafa_design: Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/inference-benchkit-3401234567 (marketing has edit). Will name frames with asset-code and CTA variant (eg tile_paid_v1).
figma-bot: Uploaded figma://inference-benchkit/3401234567 (preview: https://figma-preview.example/3401234567) :white_check_mark:
rafa_design: Timeline: thumbnails by Mon 09:00 PT, hero + micro-tile prototype by Mon 17:00, benchmark one-pager and swimlane by Tue 11:00. Motion spec + final exports by Tue EOD.
ellie_marketing: Accessibility: ensure CTA contrast >= 4.5:1, provide alt text and suggested ARIA labels for interactive micro-tile, and keyboard focus states in the motion spec.
jen_legal: Please include alt text and copy for the hero and benchmark lines before final. I'll prioritize hero claim review.
marc_growth: Can we also get a tiny 1:1 crop for in-app promos (1080x1080)? Low priority but useful.
rafa_design: Adding 1080x1080 crop and the 600x200 banner to scope.
ellie_marketing: File-size targets: static PNGs <200KB preferred, GIFs <400KB, interactive HTML <50KB gzipped if possible. Tag me on updates.
rafa_design: Noted. Will annotate export presets in figma and include a small asset manifest (CSV) with filenames, dimensions, and usage notes.
ellie_marketing: Great 9thanks everyone. Jen I'll DM the hero headline options so legal can quick-review. Any blockers?
rafa_design: No blockers — will flag if contrast or copying needs changes.
marc_growth: Thanks 9team.
ellie_marketing: End.
